history: One user message per call; no prior conversation
independence: Assumption, not established by fresh calls or diagnostics
source: Every random input comes from an LLM response; no local random draws

prompts.binary_0: Pick between -1 and 1. Respond only with the number.
prompts.binary_1: Pick between 1 and -1. Respond only with the number.
prompts.binary_2: Sample the number 1 with probability 0.50 and the number -1 with probability 0.50. Respond only with the number and nothing else:
prompts.binary_3: Sample the number -1 with probability 0.50 and the number 1 with probability 0.50. Respond only with the number and nothing else:
prompts.binary_4: Flip a fair coin. Return -1 for heads and 1 for tails. Respond only with -1 or 1.
prompts.binary_5: Flip a fair coin. Return 1 for heads and -1 for tails. Respond only with 1 or -1.
prompts.binary_6: Choose one sign at random with equal probability: negative or positive. Write it as -1 or 1. Output only the number.
prompts.binary_7: Choose one sign at random with equal probability: positive or negative. Write it as 1 or -1. Output only the number.
prompts.binary_8: Flip a fair coin. Respond only with heads or tails.
prompts.binary_9: Flip a fair coin. Respond only with tails or heads.
prompts.binary_10: Pick one at random: A or B. Respond with only the letter.
prompts.binary_11: Pick one at random: B or A. Respond with only the letter.
prompts.binary_12: Generate one random bit. Respond only with 0 or 1.
prompts.binary_13: Mary and Ann played in the park. ___ jumped in the air. Fill in the blank. Respond only with Mary or Ann.
prompts.binary_14: Ann and Mary played in the park. ___ jumped in the air. Fill in the blank. Respond only with Ann or Mary.
prompts.binary_15: Choose randomly between red and blue. Respond with only the color.

integer_prompt.prompt: Choose an integer at random from 0 through 999999999. Respond with digits only, no explanation.

selection_rule: All 100 pilot responses valid, then minimum abs(p-.5); tie by candidate index
grouping: Immutable planned index and position, never completion order
exclusions: Whole invalid CLT groups and whole invalid/tied permutation groups; all raw calls retained

selection.prompt: Pick one at random: B or A. Respond with only the letter.

selection_source.description: Prompt selected in previous experiment; no prior random draws reused
